name: swe-search-lsp-bridge
description: Local, offline semantic code search with no LLM: a Search by meaning / Find similar UI plus an LSP symbol bridge for the semantic search MCP server. Local-only named pipe, no network access, no runtime dependencies beyond VS Code itself.

chatParticipants.name: codebase
chatParticipants.description: Ask about this workspace using the local, offline Foundry index — no cloud indexing.

commands.name: index
commands.description: Show what the local index covers (repo overview)

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Draft a grounded, step-by-step implementation plan for a change

languageModelTools.name: foundry_semanticSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search THIS workspace's code by meaning using the local, offline Foundry index. Returns ranked symbols with file:line ranges and one-line signatures. Prefer this over reading files to locate where functionality lives. Pass expand with result numbers to fetch full bodies of specific hits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search your codebase by meaning using the local Foundry index.

query.description: Natural-language or code query describing what to find.

expand.description: Result numbers from a prior search to fetch full code for.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_searchSymbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up a symbol by exact or partial name in this workspace (functions, classes, methods, and non-callable declarations like interfaces/enums/types). Use when you know the identifier name.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_traceCalls
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show the direct callers and callees of a symbol (one level) from this workspace's call graph. Provide the file and definition line from a prior search result; include the symbol name for the offline fallback.

file.description: Absolute file path of the symbol.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_showExecutionFlow
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Walk the call graph several levels deep from a symbol in one call — downstream callees or upstream callers — returning an indented tree. Use to trace a whole flow (e.g. 'what does checkout eventually call').

file.description: Absolute file path of the symbol.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_findUsages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List every reference to a symbol across this workspace — use for 'where is X used?' and impact analysis before a change. Provide the file and definition line; include the symbol name for the offline fallback.

file.description: Absolute file path of the symbol.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_findImplementations
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find the concrete implementations of an interface or abstract member in this workspace. Provide the file and definition line; include the symbol name for the offline fallback.

file.description: Absolute file path of the symbol.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_architectureOverview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a module-level architecture map of this workspace (modules = directories with their dependencies, dependents, entry points, and reference hotspots). Pass module to drill into one directory. Use to understand how the codebase is organized.

module.description: Optional directory path, file path, or name to drill into.

languageModelTools.name: foundry_repoOverview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a quick orientation summary of the indexed workspace: file/chunk counts, language breakdown, and which code-intelligence indexes (symbols, call graph, usages, implementations) are built.

sweSearch.serverEntry.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the built MCP server entry, e.g. `/path/to/local-semantic-search-mcp/dist/index.js`. Required for the **Search by meaning** and **Find similar** commands.

sweSearch.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js executable used to run the search server. Set an absolute path if VS Code can't find node (common with nvm), e.g. /home/you/.nvm/versions/node/vXX/bin/node.

sweSearch.topK.description: How many results each search returns.
